quotations.quote: It was very distressing to see my Mum so anxious, angry and having hallucinations. I wanted to understand what was happening to her and to know how I could help.

quotations.quote: Following my diagnosis I was given a huge amount of literature and advice on benefit entitlement however the subject of Delirium was not mentioned.

quotations.quote: Relatives are not encouraged to advocate for their family member when they have dementia – no-one asks, What is normal for this person?

quotations.quote: He didn’t know where he was or how he had gotten there. We were worried he’d developed dementia and would never be the same.

quotations.quote: We think a lot of them assumed that, because he had a diagnosis of dementia on his file, the way he was behaving in hospital was his baseline.
